_comment: Labelled emails for the extraction/relevance eval. 'real' entries come from the user; 'synthetic' ones are written to cover gaps and should be replaced by real mails over time. now = the moment the mail is processed.

emails.note: REAL mail (user screenshots). Subject carries the date without a year ('17 September') and agrees with the body's 17-Sep-26: both must resolve to the same event, not create two. Body is a table with a dd-Mon-yy date and a time RANGE (7:30 PM-8:15 PM). 'Interviews: To be shared later' must NOT become an event (pending). The attached EXL_TIET.xlsx is the shortlist, so whether the aptitude test applies to a given student depends on whether they are on it: show the event, never hide it. Sent to a batch mailing list (campusnotice2027).
